reason: The evidence shows a Cordis profile plugin focused on integrating DSH with Telegram: users interact with DSH agents through Telegram messages, commands, and buttons, with session/model/status management, permissioned access control, and optional in-app configuration UI. That places the primary purpose in external service integration and conversational automation rather than standalone development or analysis tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个连接 DSH 与 Telegram 的 Cordis 插件，可在 Telegram 中收发消息并通过命令或按钮远程管理会话、模型、权限与状态。
summaries.en: This is a Cordis plugin that connects DSH with Telegram, enabling message forwarding and remote management of sessions, models, permissions, and status through Telegram commands and buttons.

capabilities: Telegram bot message forwarding and command handling
DSH session and model control via Telegram commands
per-user/group authorization and admin role management
persistent plugin settings via Cordis client card
remote DSH restart trigger from Telegram

reasons.code: The plugin is documented as a DSH ↔ Telegram bridge and defines Telegram commands for messaging, session/model switching, permissions, and status control
It supports multi-user/chat authorization with admin-only actions and separate conversation scopes for different chat IDs
It includes a dedicated remote restart flow and real-time response/progress forwarding for DSH agent activity
